prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Two column pick friend layout redesign: Redesign the companion selection screen into a clear two-column layout highlighting companion traits alongside pet visual previews. (why: Adoption step drop-off is high at 69.8% with an 89s median completion time, indicating users need a clearer choice overview.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet naming milestone new screen: Add a dedicated pet naming screen right after picking a friend companion style. (why: Giving the pet a name early increases emotional attachment and commitment during the adoption step.)
2: [finish, redesign] Split layout final welcome redesign: Redesign the finish screen into a split view showing desktop controls alongside a mascot welcome preview. (why: The finish step has a 64.8% conversion rate and support receives emails asking how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding.)
3: [sign_in, redesign] Two column sign in security redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a two-column layout showing cloud synchronization reassurance next to authentication options. (why: Support receives 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Instant setup value headline copy: Update path selection copy to emphasize fast instant companion adoption. (why: Choose path median time is 8s but mean is 514s, showing some users stall when picking a creation path.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop ready status background notification: Enable desktop readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app freely. (why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing users to get lost or close the app while rendering.)
6: [home, wait_info] Rendering progress and estimated time wait info: Display progress percentage and clear wait time expectations during companion rendering. (why: Home waiting screen has a high mean duration (2336s), indicating uncertainty while waiting.)
7: [sign_in, hint] Account cloud backup clarity hint: Add an explicit hint explaining that signing in prevents losing adoption progress on app restart. (why: 8 support emails complained about lost or reset pets after signing in or reopening.)
8: [adoption, hint] Adoption photo quality guidance hint: Add clear image selection tips on photo upload step to prevent custom pet generation errors. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect.)
